name: Glass Cleaner Concentrate

features.text: Removes dirt and film without streaking.
Contains alcohol and ammonia for extra cleaning ability.
Highly dilutable and economical to use.

description: A highly concentrated glass cleaner designed to cut through the toughest film on glass and mirrors. For best results dilute up to 20 to 1 with water.
application: Dilute with water and dispense with a spray bottle. To obtain maximum results, the surface should be wiped immediately with a clean cloth or paper towel after spraying.
